shortDescription: New Zealand Finance Minister Nicola Willis declined the Reserve Bank of New Zealand’s request to use NZ$10.1 million from prior-year underspending on “core” projects, according to Bloomberg.The central bank will transfer the NZ$10.1 million, or $5.9 million, back to the Crown.

children: New Zealand Finance Minister Nicola Willis declined the Reserve Bank of New Zealand’s request to use NZ$10.1 million from prior-year underspending on “core” projects, according to Bloomberg.
The central bank will transfer the NZ$10.1 million, or $5.9 million, back to the Crown.

title: GEOPOLITICS | NZ Finance Minister Rejects RBNZ Request to Keep NZ$10.1 Million
